cases.query: How much revenue did I do in August, and how does September compare so far?
cases.answer:
August revenue: $176,803.12 (data for 29 of 31 days) — 2 days have no sales records.  

September (through 2026‑09‑25) revenue: $154,222.26. Compared to the prior 25‑day window (2026‑08‑07 to 2026‑08‑31) the September figure is 0.3% higher (154,222.26 vs 153,758.21). The September period is partial, so a full‑month comparison isn’t available.
